note: File: studies/rlneurons/results/day1_3/hard328_base_cue_s4r2-01/rows.jsonl (in git, read locally; 1731 rows, no null cap_hit/score_v3/n_new and no duplicate (problem_index, sample, attempt) seen when inspecting format). Main: attempt == 0, first row per (problem_index, sample) in file order; cap hit = cap_hit true, or cap_hit missing and finish_reason == 'length'; right = score_v3 == 1 and not a cap hit (4 attempt-0 rows have score_v3 == 1 with cap_hit true; they count as not right, and at n_new = 16384 they could not fall in the late window anyway). Mass = max(0, min(n_new, b) - a)/1000 per window; event only when a <= n_new < b. Problems with ME+ML == 0 skipped; statistic = sum L*ME/M / sum E*ML/M. Denominator 0 prints refuted_without_number as the recipe says. n = number of problems kept (M_p > 0). Bootstrap resamples per-problem strata (E, ME, L, ML); a resample whose denominator is 0 gives +inf (keeps sorting well-defined). The recipe is quite explicit; alt_measured = the same statistic over all rows (restart attempts 1 and 2 kept as separate trajectories, no dedup), the reading in which restarts also count as alive trajectories. The late window holds few right finishes, so the ratio may be noisy and the interval wide.
